verses.geez: ቀዳሚሁ፡ አኮኑ፡ ጽላሎት፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕይወት፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመ፡ ሕያው፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወንብረቱ፡ ከመ፡ ሀሳብ፡ ዘለለዕለቱ።
verses.translation: Is not the life of man upon earth a state of trial? and his existence as that of a hireling by the day?

translations.lxx: Is not the life of man upon earth a state of trial? and his existence as that of a hireling by the day?
translations.kjv: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
translations.ron: Oare omul pe pământ nu este ca într-o slujbă ostăşească şi zilele lui nu sunt ca zilele unui simbriaş?
translations.grk: Πότερον οὐχὶ πειρατήριόν ἐστιν ὁ βίος ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς; καὶ ὥσπερ μισθίου αὐθημερινοῦ ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ;

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ገብር፡ ዘያደሉ፡ ለእግዚኡ፡ ወያጸምእ፡ ጸሎቶ፡ አው፡ ከመ፡ ገባኢ፡ ዘይሴፎ፡ ዓስቦ።
verses.translation: Or as a servant that fears his master, and one who has grasped a shadow? or as a hireling waiting for his pay?

translations.lxx: Or as a servant that fears his master, and one who has grasped a shadow? or as a hireling waiting for his pay?
translations.kjv: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
translations.ron: El este asemenea robului care suspină după umbră, asemenea năimitului care-şi aşteaptă simbria.
translations.grk: Ἢ ὥσπερ θεράπων δεδοικὼς τὸν Κύριον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τετευχὼς σκιᾶς; ἢ ὥσπερ μισθωτὸς ἀναμένων τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ;

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ አነሂ፡ ተዓገሥኩ፡ አውራኀ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወሌሊተኒ፡ ተውህበኒ፡ ሊተ፡ ፃዕር።
verses.translation: So have I also endured months of vanity, and nights of pain have been appointed me.

translations.lxx: So have I also endured months of vanity, and nights of pain have been appointed me.
translations.kjv: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
translations.ron: Astfel şi eu am avut parte de luni de durere, şi mi-au fost date nopţi de suferinţă.
translations.grk: Οὕτως κᾀγὼ ὑπέμεινα μῆνας κενοὺς, νύκτες δὲ ὀδυνῶν δεδομέναι μοι εἰσίν.

verses.geez: እመ፡ ኖምኩ፡ እብል፡ ማእዜ፡ ይጸብሕ፡ ሊተ፡ እንጋ፡ ወእመ፡ ነቃሕኩ፡ ካዕበ፡ እብል፡ ማእዜ፡ ይመሲ።
verses.translation: Whenever I lie down, I say, When will it be day? and whenever I rise up, again I say when will it be evening? and I am full of pains from evening to morning.

translations.lxx: Whenever I lie down, I say, When will it be day? and whenever I rise up, again I say when will it be evening? and I am full of pains from evening to morning.
translations.kjv: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
translations.ron: Dacă mă culc, zic: Când va veni ziua? Dacă mă scol, mă întreb: Când va veni seara? Şi sunt năpădit de fel de fel de arătări până la asfinţit.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν κοιμηθῶ, λέγω, πότε ἡμέρα; ὡς δʼ ἂν ἀναστῶ, πάλιν, πότε ἑσπέρα; πλήρης δὲ γίνομαι ὀδυνῶν ἀπὸ ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωΐ.

verses.geez: ጸገብኩ፡ ሕማመ፡ እምነግህ፡ እስከ፡ ሠርክ፡ ወባኍበኈ፡ ሥጋየ፡ በፅሄያት፡ ወመግል፡ ወኃለቁ፡ እንዘ፡ አሐክክ፡ ጸውበ፡ ወእንጳንጴ፡ ወሐመደ፡ ኮንኩ።
verses.translation: And my body is covered with loathsome worms; and I waste away, scraping off clods of dust from my eruption.

translations.lxx: And my body is covered with loathsome worms; and I waste away, scraping off clods of dust from my eruption.
translations.kjv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
translations.ron: Trupul meu e plin de păduchi şi de solzi de murdărie; pielea mea crapă şi se zbârceşte.
translations.grk: Φύρεται δέ μου τὸ σῶμα ἐν σαπρίᾳ σκωλήκων, τήκω δὲ βώλακας γῆς ἀπὸ ἰχῶρος ξύων.

verses.geez: ወቀላለ፡ ኮነት፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ከመ፡ ነገረ፡ ዘየአንም፡ ወተኃጐልኩ፡ በተሰፍዎ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: And my life is lighter than a word, and has perished in vain hope.

translations.lxx: And my life is lighter than a word, and has perished in vain hope.
translations.kjv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
translations.ron: Zilele mele au fost mai grabnice ca suveica şi s-au isprăvit, fiindcă firul s-a terminat.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ βίος μου ἔστιν ἐλαφρότερος λαλιᾶς, ἀπόλωλε δὲ ἐν κενῇ ἐλπίδι.

verses.geez: ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ነፍስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕይትየ፡ ወኢትገብእ፡ እንከ፡ ትርአይ፡ ዓይንየ፡ ሠናይተ፡፡ 8፡ ወኢይሬኢ፡ ዓይነ፡ ዘይሬአየኒ፡ ወእመኒ፡ ነጸረኒ፡ ኢይሄሎ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: Remember then that my life is breath, and mine eye shall not yet again see good.

translations.lxx: Remember then that my life is breath, and mine eye shall not yet again see good.
translations.kjv: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte, Doamne, că viaţa mea e o suflare, că ochiul meu nu va mai vedea fericirea.
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι οὖν ὅτι πνεῦμά μου ἡ ζωὴ, καὶ οὐκ ἔτι ἐπανελεύσεται ὀφθαλμός μου ἰδεῖν ἀγαθόν.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ደመና፡ ዘተነጽሐ፡ እምሰማይ፡ እስመ፡ እምከመ፡ ወረደ፡ ሰብአ፡ ውስተ፡ መቃብር፡ ኢየዓርግ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: I am as a cloud that is cleared away from the sky: for if a man go down to the grave, he shall not come up again:

translations.lxx: I am as a cloud that is cleared away from the sky: for if a man go down to the grave, he shall not come up again:
translations.kjv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
translations.ron: Negura se risipeşte, piere, tot astfel cel ce coboară în iad nu mai vine înapoi.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ νέφος ἀποκαθαρθὲν ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ· ἐὰν γὰρ ἄνθρωπος καταβῇ εἰς ᾅδην, οὐκ ἔτι μὴ ἀναβῇ,

verses.geez: ወኢይገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤት፡ ወኢየአምር፡ እንከ፡ ብሔሮ።
verses.translation: and he shall surely not return to his own house, neither shall his place know him any more.

translations.lxx: and he shall surely not return to his own house, neither shall his place know him any more.
translations.kjv: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
translations.ron: Nu se mai înapoiază în casa sa şi locuinţa sa nu-l mai cunoaşte.
translations.grk: οὐδʼ οὐ μὴ ἐπιστρέψῃ εἰς τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον, οὐδʼ οὐ μὴ ἐπιγνῶ αὐτὸν ἔτι ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አነሂ፡ ኢይምህከ፡ አፉየ፡ ወእነብብ፡ ፃዕረ፡ መንፈስየ፡ ወአከሥት፡ ምረረ፡ ነፍስየ፡ ዘላዕሌየ፡ ከመ፡ ወባሕር፡ ኮነ፡ አንብዕየ።
verses.translation: Then neither will I refrain my mouth: I will speak being in distress; being in anguish I will disclose the bitterness of my soul.

translations.lxx: Then neither will I refrain my mouth: I will speak being in distress; being in anguish I will disclose the bitterness of my soul.
translations.kjv: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
translations.ron: Drept aceea nu voi pune strajă gurii mele, ci voi vorbi întru deznădejdea duhului meu şi mă voi plânge întru amărăciunea inimii mele.
translations.grk: Ἀτὰρ οὖν οὐδὲ ἐγὼ φείσομαι τῷ στόματί μου, λαλήσω ἐν ἀνάγκῃ ὤν, ἀνοίξω πικρίαν ψυχῆς μου συνεχόμενος.

verses.geez: ባሕርኑ፡ አው፡ ቀላይ፡ እስመ፡ አዘዝከ፡ ዓቃቤ፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: Am I a sea, or a serpent, that thou hast set a watch over me?

translations.lxx: Am I a sea, or a serpent, that thou hast set a watch over me?
translations.kjv: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
translations.ron: Sunt eu, oare, oceanul sau balaurul din ocean, ca să pui să mă păzească?
translations.grk: Πότερον θάλασσα εἰμὶ ἢ δράκων, ὅτι κατέταξας ἐπʼ ἐμὲ φυλακήν;

verses.geez: ወእቤ፡ ዓራትየኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ይናዝዘኒ፡ ወያልህየኒሁ፡ እንጋ፡ ምስካብየ።
verses.translation: I said that my bed should comfort me, and I would privately counsel with myself on my couch.

translations.lxx: I said that my bed should comfort me, and I would privately counsel with myself on my couch.
translations.kjv: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
translations.ron: Când gândesc: Patul meu mă va odihni, culcuşul meu îmi va alina durerile,
translations.grk: Εἴπα ὅτι παρακαλέσει με ἡ κλίνη μου, ἀνοίσω δὲ πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν ἰδίᾳ λόγον τῇ κοίτῃ μου.

verses.translation: Thou scarest me with dreams, and dost terrify me with visions.

translations.lxx: Thou scarest me with dreams, and dost terrify me with visions.
translations.kjv: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
translations.ron: Atunci Tu mă spăimântezi cu vise şi mă îngrozeşti cu năluciri.
translations.grk: Ἐκφοβεῖς με ἐνυπνίοις, καὶ ὁράμασί με καταπλήσσεις.

verses.geez: ወኮነ፡ ሥሉጠ፡ በነፍስየ፡ ወበመንፈስየ፡ ወአሞቶን፡ ለአዕይንትየ፡ ቦኑ፡ ለዓለም፡ አሐዩ፡ ከመ፡ እትዓገሥ፡ ርኅቀ፡ እምኔየ፡ ወከንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕይወትየ።
verses.translation: Thou wilt separate life from my spirit; and yet keep my bones from death.

translations.lxx: Thou wilt separate life from my spirit; and yet keep my bones from death.
translations.kjv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea, sufletul meu ar vrea mai bine ştreangul, mai bine moartea decât aceste chinuri.
translations.grk: Ἀπαλλάξεις ἀπὸ πνεύματός μου τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἀπὸ δὲ θανάτου τὰ ὀστᾶ μου.

verses.geez: ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ሰብአ፡ ከመ፡ ታዕብዮ፡ ወከመ፡ ተሐውጽ፡ ልቦ።
verses.translation: For I shall not live for ever, that I should patiently endure: depart from me, for my life is vain.

translations.lxx: For I shall not live for ever, that I should patiently endure: depart from me, for my life is vain.
translations.kjv: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
translations.ron: Mă isprăvesc, nu voi trăi în veac; lasă-mă, căci zilele mele sunt o suflare.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ζήσομαι, ἵνα μακροθυμήσω· ἀπόστα ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, κενὸς γάρ μου ὁ βίος.

verses.geez: አው፡ ከመ፡ ትፍትኖ፡ እስከ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ ኀቤከ፡ አው፡ ከመ፡ ትኰንኖ፡ በውስተ፡ ዓራቱ።
verses.translation: For what is man, that thou hast magnified him? or that thou givest heed to him?

translations.lxx: For what is man, that thou hast magnified him? or that thou givest heed to him?
translations.kjv: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
translations.ron: Ce este omul, ca să-ţi baţi capul cu el şi ca să-i dai luarea Ta aminte?
translations.grk: Τί γάρ ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος, ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνας αὐτόν; ἢ ὅτι προσέχεις τὸν νοῦν εἰς αὐτόν;

verses.geez: እስከ፡ ማእዜኑ፡ ኢታስሕተኒ፡ እስከ፡ እውኅጥ፡ ምራቅየ፡ እንዘ፡ የሐንቀኒ።
verses.translation: Wilt thou visit him till the morning, and judge him till the time of rest?

translations.lxx: Wilt thou visit him till the morning, and judge him till the time of rest?
translations.kjv: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
translations.ron: De ce îl cercetezi în fiecare dimineaţă şi de ce îl urmăreşti în orice clipă?
translations.grk: Ἢ ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ ποιήσῃ ἕως τὸ πρωΐ; καὶ εἰς ἀνάπαυσιν αὐτὸν κρινεῖς;

verses.geez: ወእነሂ፡ አበስኩ፡ አነ፡ ምንተ፡ እንከ፡ እክል፡ ገቢረ፡ ለከ፡ ኦ፡ ዘተአምር፡ ልበ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ለምንት፡ ረፅይከኒ፡ ለመቅሠፍት፡ ለከ፡ ወለምንት፡ ፈጠርከኒ፡ በአምሳሊከ፡ አነሁ፡ ዳአሙ፡ ከበድኩከ።
verses.translation: How long dost thou not let me alone, nor let me go, until I shall swallow down my spittle?

translations.lxx: How long dost thou not let me alone, nor let me go, until I shall swallow down my spittle?
translations.kjv: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
translations.ron: Când vei înceta să mă priveşti? Când îmi vei da răgaz să-mi înghit saliva?
translations.grk: Ἕως τίνος οὐκ ἐᾷς με, οὐδὲ προΐῃ με, ἕως ἂν καταπίω τὸν πτύελόν μου;

verses.geez: ወለምንት፡ ኢገበርከ፡ በዘይትረሳዕ፡ ኃጢአትየ፡ ወበዘይነጽሕ፡ ጌጋይየ፡ ወይአዜሰ፡ እወርድ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ኀበ፡ ኢይነቅሕ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: If I have sinned, what shall I be able to do, O thou that understandest the mind of men? why hast thou made me as thine accuser, and why am I a burden to thee?

translations.lxx: If I have sinned, what shall I be able to do, O thou that understandest the mind of men? why hast thou made me as thine accuser, and why am I a burden to thee?
translations.kjv: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
translations.ron: Dacă am greşit, ce ţi-am făcut ţie, Păzitorule de oameni? De ce m-ai luat ţintă pentru săgeţile Tale şi de ce ţi-am ajuns povară?
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐγὼ ἥμαρτον, τί δυνήσομαι πρᾶξαι, ὁ ἐπιστάμενος τὸν νοῦν τῶν ἀνθρώπων; διατί ἔθου με κατεντευκτήν σου, εἰμὶ δὲ ἐπὶ σοὶ φορτίον;
